notes: Supanova is one brand across six Australian cities sharing a guest database; this file covers only the Adelaide show. The /events/adelaide-2026/guests/ page already lists every confirmed Adelaide guest in one grid (many also tour to Brisbane, shown by a second 'Brisbane 2026' tag on the same card, which does not exclude them here). Guest cat sometimes overrides Supanova's own on-site category tag to match this schema: e.g. David Bateson and Neil Fanning are tagged 'Gaming'/'Film & TV' on the site but are voice performers (Agent 47, Scooby-Doo) so are filed as 'voice' here. Refute-pass (2026-10-05): re-extracted fresh (pipeline/cache/extract/supanova-adelaide-v2.guests.json) -- all 55 picks carry 'Adelaide 2026' directly in their own card text (e.g. #7 Karl Urban 'Adelaide 2026 Film & TV Sunday Only'), so the scan's 'photos look older' flag is just old WordPress media-library upload folders (/2009/, /2011/, /2017/ …) being reused for recurring celebrity guests, not a stale page; lineup upheld in full.
